## USV Labs {#usv-labs}

### Lab 1: Make It Work — System Identification

- Assignment: [lab1_sysid.pdf](../../weeks/w03_lab_usv_sysid/files/lab1_sysid.pdf). Deliverable changed to a slide deck summary: see [lab1_sysid.pptx](../../weeks/w03_lab_usv_sysid/files/lab1_sysid.pptx)
- Cube Orange+ autopilot wiring: copy the example USV and/or use the [Cube wiring quick start](https://docs.px4.io/main/en/assembly/quick_start_cube) and telemetry [RFD900x setup](https://mozzie.readthedocs.io/en/latest/RFD900xSetup.html)

  - The data is already converted, but just in case, the Python BIN-to-MAT converter: [bin2mat.py](https://github.com/bsb808/introduction-to-feedback-control/blob/main/utils/ardu_utils/bin2mat.py)
